test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 25th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Frivolous
solution: The correct answer is '**Wise**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate antonym of the given word '**Frivolous**' is '**Wise**'. • **Frivolous**: not serious; silly. (अगंभीर; मूर्खतापूर्ण) • *Example: I do not raise that in any **frivolous** spirit, but it seems to me to be somewhat important.* • **Wise**: having the knowledge or experience to make good and sensible decisions and judgements. [बुद्धिमान, समझदार या अक़लमंद व्‍यक्ति (विवेकपूर्ण निर्णय लेने के लिए अपेक्षित ज्ञान या अनुभव से संपन्‍न)] • *Example: a **wise** choice...* **Correct Answer:__** *Wise.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Quiet**: with very little or no noise. (शांत, ख़ामोश) • **Idle**: not wanting to work hard; lazy. (मेहनत से जी चुराने वाला, कामचोर; आलसी) • **Petty**: small and unimportant. (छोटा और नगण्य) 218:T83e, The erroneous part is** 'for extending'.**
